// A sibling `tests.rs`: every fn here is test code.
use super::*;

#[test]
fn a_dropped_listener_is_reported() {
    let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").expect("bind");
    let addr = listener.local_addr().expect("addr");
    drop(listener);
    connect(addr);
}

#[test]
fn a_block_scoped_listener_is_reported() {
    let addr = {
        let l = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
        l.local_addr().unwrap()
    };
    connect(addr);
}

// A helper that hands out a freed port is the same race for every caller.
fn a_free_port_helper_is_reported() -> u16 {
    let sock: TcpListener =
        TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    sock
        .local_addr()
        .unwrap()
        .port()
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_temporary_listener_is_reported() {
    let addr = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap().local_addr().unwrap();
    connect(addr);
}

#[test]
fn an_accepting_listener_is_not_reported() {
    let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let _ = listener.accept();
    });
    connect(addr);
}

#[test]
fn a_listener_handed_to_a_responder_is_not_reported() {
    let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    spawn_responder_on(listener);
    connect(addr);
}

#[test]
fn a_listener_served_in_a_loop_is_not_reported() {
    let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    for stream in listener.incoming() {
        drop(stream);
    }
}

#[test]
fn a_bind_quoted_in_a_string_is_not_reported() {
    let text = "let l = TcpListener::bind(x); l.local_addr()";
    assert!(!text.is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn the_refusing_address_is_not_reported() {
    connect(anodizer_core::test_helpers::refusing_addr::refusing_addr());
}

#[test]
fn a_parenthesised_bind_argument_is_reported() {
    let addr = TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)).unwrap().local_addr().unwrap();
    connect(addr);
}

#[test]
fn an_address_read_inside_a_closure_is_reported() {
    let addr = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").and_then(|l| l.local_addr()).unwrap();
    connect(addr);
}

#[test]
fn a_setter_call_does_not_keep_the_listener() {
    let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    listener.set_nonblocking(true).unwrap();
    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    drop(listener);
    connect(addr);
}

#[test]
fn a_let_underscore_does_not_keep_the_listener() {
    let addr = {
        let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
        let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
        let _ = listener;
        addr
    };
    connect(addr);
}

#[test]
fn a_rebound_name_ends_the_first_listener() {
    let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let _ = listener.accept();
    });
    connect(addr);
}

#[test]
fn a_server_that_never_answers_is_not_reported() {
    let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    connect_and_time_out(addr);
}

#[test]
fn a_listener_kept_in_a_struct_is_not_reported() {
    let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    let server = Server { listener };
    connect(addr);
    server.shutdown();
}

#[test]
fn a_listener_served_as_a_temporary_is_not_reported() {
    serve(TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap());
}
